property_summary: For every pending flash-governance decision created via assertGovernanceApproved, the reference C's withdrawGovernanceAsset succeeds only after the unlockTime has strictly passed, so at exactly unlockTime the pending decision must remain with its original amount, whereas the mutant allows withdrawal at equality and deletes it.
change_summary: Change the unlockTime condition from < block.timestamp to <= block.timestamp in the require guard.
